summary: Comprehensive testing of mobile checkout funnel fixes (iteration 67). All P0 and P1 features verified working correctly. Mobile fabric detail sticky CTA buttons (Quote, Sample, Book Bulk) are tappable and open BottomSheet. CTA bar stays fixed at viewport bottom during scroll with z-index 100 (above PWA install banner z-index 90). No 64px gap - bar is flush with bottom. Mobile checkout auto-fills address from past orders after WhatsApp OTP login. PWA InstallPrompt correctly suppressed on /m/fabric/* and /m/checkout pages. Tab bar visibility correct: shown on /m, /m/catalog, hidden on /m/fabric/<id> and /m/checkout.
critical_code_review_comments: MFabricDetail.js: Sticky CTA bar correctly uses position:fixed, left:50%, transform:translateX(-50%), bottom:0, zIndex:100
MFabricDetail.js: CTA buttons have proper data-testid attributes (m-quote, m-book-sample, m-book-bulk, m-booking-confirm)
MCheckout.js: Address prefill effect correctly fetches profile + saved-addresses with fallback chain
MobileLayout.js: HIDE_TABS correctly hides tab bar on fabric detail and checkout pages
seed_data_creation: Created test customer with phone 919999988888 and seeded order LF/TEST/M67 with shipping address for auto-fill testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile checkout funnel fully tested. Test customer phone: 919999988888. OTP can be retrieved from db.customer_otps collection. Address auto-fill works from both customer profile and saved-addresses fallback. CTA z-index is 100, install banner z-index is 90.

p0_mobile_cta_tappable.details: Quote, Sample, Book Bulk buttons on /m/fabric/<id> are tappable. Clicking Sample/Bulk opens BottomSheet with quantity selector and 'Continue to checkout' button.

p0_mobile_cta_sticky_bottom.details: CTA bar uses position:fixed, bottom:0, zIndex:100. Bar stays at viewport bottom during scroll (top→middle→bottom). Gap from viewport bottom is only 10px (safe area), no 64px gap.

p0_mobile_checkout_navigation.details: Clicking 'Continue to checkout' in BottomSheet navigates to /m/checkout with correct query params (fabric, qty, type, variant).

p0_mobile_checkout_address_autofill.details: After WhatsApp OTP login, shipping form auto-fills: name='Mobile Test User', phone='919999988888', address='42 Fashion Street, Andheri West', city='Mumbai', state='Maharashtra', pincode='400058'

p0_saved_address_picker.details: SavedAddressPicker shows 'SHIP TO A SAVED ADDRESS' with past order address displayed as quick-fill option

p1_pwa_install_suppression_fabric.details: /m/fabric/* path matches SUPPRESS_PREFIXES, install banner not rendered

p1_pwa_install_suppression_checkout.details: /m/checkout path matches SUPPRESS_PREFIXES, install banner not rendered

p1_pwa_install_allowed_catalog.details: /m/catalog does NOT match SUPPRESS_PREFIXES, install banner allowed to render

p1_cta_zindex_above_install_banner.details: CTA bar z-index is 100, install banner z-index is 90. CTA taps cannot be intercepted by install banner.

regression_tab_bar_visible_home.details: /m shows bottom tab bar with 5 tabs (Home, Catalog, Quote, Orders, Account)

regression_tab_bar_hidden_fabric_detail.details: /m/fabric/<id> hides tab bar, shows CTA buttons instead
